title: A/B Testing
description: A practical, advanced course on A/B Testing. Learn by doing with guided lessons, exercises, and a final assessment.
outcomes: Explain the key concepts of A/B Testing
Apply A/B Testing to real-world scenarios
Complete a practical project using A/B Testing
Assess your own work and improve
tools: A text editor or relevant software

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn the essentials of a/b testing part 1 and how to apply data & analytics in real work.
Core concept: A/B Testing Part 1
Every skilled practitioner starts by understanding the fundamentals of A/B Testing Part 1. This lesson walks you through the key ideas, common mistakes, and a practical example you can try today.

items: The definition and purpose of A/B Testing Part 1
When to use A/B Testing Part 1 versus alternatives
A step-by-step walkthrough
Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

content.title: Remember
content.text: Practice A/B Testing Part 1 with real examples before moving to the next lesson.

content.question: What is the main goal of A/B Testing Part 1?
content.explanation: The goal of A/B Testing Part 1 is to build a solid foundation you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying A/B Testing Part 1 to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
